# Municipal Ordinance No. 08, Series of 2005

**Real Property Tax Discount Ordinance**

## Summary

This ordinance grants discounts to real property taxpayers in Pitogo, Quezon, based on [[Sec-342-RA7160|Section 342]] of the [[RA-7160|Local Government Code of 1991]]. It provides a 30% discount for delinquent taxpayers, a 10% discount for prompt taxpayers, and a 20% discount for advance paying taxpayers on the municipal share of the real property tax. The ordinance aims to help taxpayers cope with agricultural challenges and encourage timely tax payments.

## Key Provisions

1.  **Section 1.** – Grants a 30% discount (Municipal Share) to delinquent tax payers.
2.  **Section 2.** – Grants a 10% discount (Municipal Share) to prompt tax payers.
3.  **Section 3.** – Grants a 20% discount (Municipal Share) to advance paying tax payers.
4.  **Section 4.** – The discount is only valid within one year of its approval.
5.  **Section 5.** – The [[Pambayang Ingat Yaman]] is instructed to inform the residents of Pitogo, Quezon about the discounts mentioned in Sections 1 to 3.
6.  **Section 6.** – Any Municipal Ordinance that contradicts this ordinance is repealed.
7.  **Section 7.** – This Municipal Ordinance shall take effect ten (10) days after its approval.
